restaurantName: The Orangery at St Elphin's Park
bio: St Elphin's Park is set within 14-acres of landscaped grounds, not far from Matlock and Bakewell. It sits on the border between the Derbyshire Dales and the Peak District National Park.  The centrepiece building of St Elphin's Park is a well-known former girls' boarding school. This building has been lovingly restored stone by stone and it now houses the Orangery Restaurant.  Their Orangery Restaurant serves a traditional Afternoon Tea, that is comprised of a selection of seasonal sandwiches, homemade scones with jam and clotted cream, homemade cake and biscuits.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.  Afternoon Tea is available from 2pm - 5pm
pageTitle: The Orangery at St Elphin's Park
